STEAL THE TREASURE  -  4 player arena game
==========================================
1. Double-click Play.bat  (it connects to the game server automatically).
2. One player clicks "Create Room" and shares the join string shown in the lobby
   (looks like 13.236.233.60:7777/ABCDE). Friends click "Join Room", paste it, and join.
3. The host presses Start.

Controls:  WASD / arrows move | Space shoot (sends enemies home) | Shift or J leap over water and low fences
           T or Enter chat (/w name text = private message) | M mute | + / - volume | F2 weather on/off | Esc leave

Goal: steal a trophy from an enemy base and carry it to your own base. First to the target score wins.
If Windows SmartScreen warns about the exe: "More info" -> "Run anyway" (the game is not code-signed).
Do not move game_client.exe out of this folder: it needs the "Ninja Adventure - Asset Pack" folder next to it.

Credits: art & sounds from the "Ninja Adventure" asset pack (pixel-boy, CC0).
Extra music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0 - see Audio/MusicExtra/CREDITS.txt.
